set.body:
Objective
Support numeric and identified multiresponse targets, training-only hyperparameter selection, exact-coverage cross-fitting, explicit per-output/pooled metrics and optional refit.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements PRED-01, FND-04, FND-09, INF-05. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
implementation; predictive workflow adapters; OperatorRidge and FeatureModel migration seams. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M1.06, M1.E1. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Outer test evidence cannot tune rank, penalties, covariance, target scaling or feature selection; expose nested training lineage.
2. Feature-block weights and target axes survive fitted artifacts, OOF outputs and prediction APIs.
3. Cross-fit coverage is validated independently from validation split coverage; target-aware row preparation cannot use its own target.
4. Refitting has a separate use/receipt; degenerate or unestimable targets have a typed policy and no invented R-squared.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M1.08: Integrate nested tuning, cross-fitting, and scalar/multiresponse regression
